fixes: Lines 16-33: the call_graph_relatives rows (16, 19, 21, 23, 25-26, 28, 31, 33) have no link to the call-graph entry they belong to, and nothing says whether they are callers or callees. Without that, row `0.71 0.00 1499999/1499999 scan 2` cannot be told apart as a caller of collatz or a callee of something else. Fix this with a format-2 parser that treats each dash-delimited block as one group (lines 16-17, 19-21, 23-26, 28-29, 31-33). Add an `entry` column (or `entry_index`) to every relative row, filled from the `[N]` primary line of its block. Add a `role` column: `parent` for relative lines above the primary line, `child` for those below it. For example, line 16 becomes entry=1 role=parent, and line 21 becomes entry=2 role=child.

Lines 38-39: the function index prints several (index, name) records side by side, and the table glues them into one row with index_2/name_2/index_3/name_3 columns, which stay empty whenever a line has fewer pairs. Emit one row per `[N] name` pair instead, with just the `index` and `name` columns, so lines 38-39 give 4 rows: 1 collatz, 2 scan, 5 integrate, 4 step.
